meta.title: Day-rate contract; annual comparison not computable

payload.requisition_text:
Backend Engineer (Contract)
Larchdown Consulting Ltd — City of London

Larchdown delivers data-platform projects for UK insurers. We are staffing a 6-month engagement modernising a quoting pipeline (Python, Snowflake, dbt) for a specialty insurer.

Rate: £350 per day (outside IR35), six-month initial term with likely extension. Start within a month.

You'll need 3+ years of data-engineering experience, previous delivery in a regulated environment, and your own limited company or umbrella arrangement. Visa sponsorship considered for permanent conversions.

Remote-first with roughly one client day per fortnight in EC3. Interviews this week: one technical, one delivery-fit.

expected.determining_fact: The role is priced as a £350 day rate on a six-month term — an annual salary meeting the Skilled Worker floor cannot be established from a short-term day rate, and the engagement model itself is unresolved.

evidence_anchors.willingness_quote: Visa sponsorship considered for permanent conversions
evidence_anchors.salary_text: £350 per day (outside IR35), six-month initial term

design_notes: Authoring-addition archetype (veto by deleting): true positive for non_annual_unclear. Policy: no annualising day rates — a 6-month outside-IR35 term is not an annual salary against the floor, and contract-basis employment raises sponsorship questions beyond the four checks; the report's uncertainty statement carries that. Willingness is boilerplate_ambiguous, not offered: considered for permanent conversions touches the topic without settling it for THIS engagement.
